findings: Label order and stable per-pair softmax correct; no confidence threshold in the canonical review controller.
Original 65 mismatched call instances represent 26 distinct text/indicator pairs and 67 changed hypothesis votes.
18/67 changed votes have top-two margins <=0.05; errors also occur at top score 0.814 and margin 0.690; these are descriptive bins, not decision thresholds.
22 review fields changed: 8 needs_review flags and 14 review_reasons; no evidence/semantic-status/candidate-state changes.
The negation-case mismatch was on the separate boilerplate unit We are Contoso.; negative directives stayed context-blocked. Quotation/hypothetical cases had no recorded disagreements.

No integer arithmetic mismatch in 31,104 sampled cells; no sampled saturation fingerprint. Disabling graph optimizations reproduced identical original INT8 logits on one frozen worst-case call. This does not rule out every possible kernel issue.

Same-input component probes isolate activation rounding: early feed-forward nodes have roughly 4.1%-10.6% activation-only local RMS error versus 0.50%-0.75% weight-only error; activation maxima reach about 94-96 times RMS on two probes.
Per-tensor U8 activation quantization around outliers is the dominant measured local error mechanism; propagated quantization error alters NLI argmax/three-hypothesis agreement.
Preserving only the two earliest sensitive blocks is insufficient. Quantizing only the lowest-local-error final attention-output projection preserves all frozen decisions.
